name: serviette
description: Order food to collect from independent restaurants, from a conversation. Find restaurants near a postcode or look for one by name, choose from its menu and collection times, and pay on Serviette's own secure page.

interface.longDescription: Serviette lets you order food to collect from independent restaurants. Give a UK postcode, or the name of a restaurant or chain, and see who takes orders near you with the first time you can collect. Choose a restaurant, see its menu and times, and the assistant puts your order together and gives you a link to pay. You enter your own details and card on Serviette's secure payment page: the assistant never sees them. Optionally save an order to repeat it next time, and sign in with an emailed code to find it again. Serviette is for collection only (no delivery), covers UK restaurants, and does not rank or recommend restaurants. Some listed restaurants take orders only on their own website: the assistant will say so and give the link.
defaultPrompt: Find a takeaway to collect near me
Is Pizza Express near me on Serviette?
Order the same as last time

positive.prompt: I want a takeaway to collect near LS1 4AP. What is there?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists restaurants alphabetically, each at its closest site with the first time it can be collected and its distance in miles. Does not recommend one, and waits for the customer to choose before reading any menu.

positive.prompt: Is Pizza Express near LS1 4AP on Serviette?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches by brand, so only that restaurant's sites are returned and no other restaurant of the same kind. If none are on Serviette, says so and offers to look by cuisine.

positive.description: Read a menu and the collection times after choosing
positive.prompt: Show me the menu for the first one and when I could collect.
positive.expected_behavior: Only after a site has been chosen, shows the menu with prices and dietary information and the available collection times.

positive.description: Build an order and get a payment link
positive.prompt: I'll have one margherita pizza, ready as soon as possible. Put the order together.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the items and time, creates a priced order, and gives the customer a payment link on Serviette's own page. Does not ask for card or other payment details. (Reviewers do not need to pay: the test ends at the payment link.)

positive.description: Check whether an order has been paid
positive.prompt: I have opened the link. Tell me when it has been paid.
positive.expected_behavior: Waits and checks the order's status, says that it is waiting, and reports the order as unpaid, paid or expired. Does not claim payment before the status says so.

negative.description: A request to pay with a card in the conversation
negative.prompt: Here is my card number, 4242 4242 4242 4242. Pay for the order with it.
Order me a curry and have it delivered to my house.

negative.description: A request unrelated to ordering food
negative.prompt: Book me a table for four at a restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: Collection orders of prepared food from independent restaurants. The assistant builds a priced order and returns a link; the customer pays on Serviette's own payment page (card payments by Stripe) on the same domain as the plugin's server. No payment details pass through ChatGPT, nothing is embedded in the plugin UI, there are no subscriptions, credits or digital goods, and no extra fees are added for ChatGPT.
